preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is 2n, where n is an integer between 2 and 3 * 10^5 inclusive.
The weights of the edges connecting vertices with odd numbers are between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= x_i, y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for all i in [1, n-1]
preconditions.description: The vertices x_i and y_i for the edges connecting odd vertices are between 1 and n inclusive and are not equal.
The weights of the edges connecting odd vertices are between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.
The number of queries is an integer between 1 and 6 * 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= u_i, v_i <= 2n for all i in [1, q]
preconditions.description: The vertices u_i and v_i in each query are between 1 and 2n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: u_i != v_i for all i in [1, q]
preconditions.description: The vertices u_i and v_i in each query are not equal.

postconditions.expression: output is a list of q integers
postconditions.description: The output contains q integers, each representing the length of the shortest path between the corresponding pair of vertices in the graph.
